## Home: native top bar like Library and Settings

- At the very top, Home shows nothing behind the PC/status capsule: the game artwork runs to the top edge, as before.
- When you scroll down, the system navigation bar appears like it does on Library and Settings: the native scroll-edge blur under the bar and the title **Play Now** in the middle.
- The background art now sits behind the Home list instead of beside it, so iOS recognises the list and draws its own bar effect.
